now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#17
now.text: When Fitz flees Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D., Lance Hunter helps him shake Gonzales' agents, and the two go on the run with Coulson.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A good friend Hunter goes on the run with from Gonzales.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A good friend Fitz goes on the run with from Gonzales.

proposed.text: When Fitz opens Fury's Toolbox to reach Coulson while Robert Gonzales' agents tail him, Lance Hunter talks him through how to shake the tail.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A good friend Hunter talks through shaking Gonzales' agents.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A good friend who helps Fitz shake Gonzales' agents.

changes.evidence: In 'Melinda' (S2#17) Fitz, hiding in a restaurant restroom from Gonzales' agents, opens the Toolbox, contacts Coulson and Hunter, and Hunter tells him how to shake the tail using the hand dryer. Fitz only escapes and joins Coulson, Hunter and Mike on the Quinjet in 'The Frenemy of My Enemy' (S2#18), so 'the two go on the run with Coulson' (text and both card lines) is the next episode's event.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#17
now.text: Andrew Garner, May's ex-husband, secretly counsels Phil Coulson about his urge to carve alien writing.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Andrew secretly counsels about carving alien writing.
now.on_b_card_about_a: May's ex-husband, who secretly counsels Coulson about the alien writing.

proposed.text: Andrew Garner, May's ex-husband, has been meeting with Phil Coulson in secret, and May uncovers it while looking into Coulson's hidden plans.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Andrew secretly meets with.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: May's ex-husband, who secretly meets with Coulson.

changes.evidence: In 'Melinda' (S2#17) May only finds that Coulson has been secretly consulting Garner (Mack suspects it is for a gifted army); Coulson reveals the meetings were counseling for his alien-writing impulses in 'The Dirty Half Dozen' (S2#19). The S2#17 text and card lines give away the S2#19 reveal.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#19
now.text: After Mike breaks free of HYDRA's control as Deathlok, Fitz and Jemma repair his cybernetic parts, and he becomes a friend to the team.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A friend whose cybernetic parts Fitz repairs.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who repairs Mike's cybernetic parts.

proposed.text: After Mike is rescued from HYDRA, Fitz tells him HYDRA dismantled his leg and promises to send him to a facility where he can be rebuilt.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Fitz promises to have rebuilt after HYDRA's experiments.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who promises to get Mike rebuilt.

changes.evidence: In 'The Dirty Half Dozen' (S2#19) Fitz and Simmons only discuss repairing Mike's destroyed cybernetic parts; Fitz tells him his leg was dismantled and that they are sending him to a facility to be helped. No repair by Fitz is shown; Mike is rebuilt off screen. Breaking free of HYDRA's control was S1#22.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#16
now.text: Lincoln Campbell lives at Afterlife and trusts Gordon, the teleporter who is the community's only link to the outside world.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Inhuman at Afterlife who trusts Gordon.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Afterlife's teleporter and its only link to the outside world.

proposed.text: At Afterlife, Lincoln Campbell trusts Gordon, the teleporter who is the community's only link to the outside world.

changes.evidence: In 'Afterlife' (S2#16) Skye asks if Lincoln lives at Afterlife and he says nobody does; he lives in Cincinnati, where he is finishing medical school. 'Lincoln Campbell lives at Afterlife' is wrong.
